scripts.build: pnpm run build:foundation && tsc -p packages/quality-contracts && tsc -p packages/catalog && tsc -p packages/security && tsc -p packages/kingsman && tsc -p packages/harbor && tsc -p packages/sdk && pnpm run build:quality
scripts.build:adapters: tsc -p packages/adapter-drizzle && tsc -p packages/adapter-aws && tsc -p packages/adapter-app
scripts.verify:build: pnpm run verify:sdk-layout && pnpm run build && pnpm run catalog:refresh && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:hooks && pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run typecheck:sdk && pnpm run test:vitest:verify && pnpm run typecheck:platforms && pnpm run consolidation:verify
scripts.build:quality: tsc -p packages/observability && tsc -p packages/quality-contracts && tsc -p packages/quality-node-diagnostics && tsc -p packages/quality-browser-runtime && tsc -p packages/quality-core && tsc -p packages/backend-quality && tsc -p packages/frontend-quality && tsc -p packages/cli
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:hooks && pnpm run build:murphi-ui && pnpm --filter @sapling/example-web run build
scripts.typecheck:quality: pnpm run build:quality && pnpm run build:hooks && pnpm run build:murphi-ui && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api
scripts.build:quality:local: tsc -p packages/observability && tsc -p packages/quality-contracts && tsc -p packages/quality-node-diagnostics && tsc -p packages/quality-core && tsc -p packages/backend-quality && tsc -p packages/quality-browser-runtime && tsc -p packages/frontend-quality/tsconfig.local.json && tsc -p packages/cli
scripts.build:foundation: tsc -p packages/observability && tsc -p packages/utils && tsc -p packages/validations && tsc -p packages/realtime && tsc -p packages/middleware
scripts.technical:evaluate: node scripts/technical-evaluation.mjs && pnpm run docs:features && pnpm run docs:verify && pnpm run saas:audit && pnpm run platform:coverage && pnpm run test:vitest:verify
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:adapters && pnpm run build:hooks && pnpm run build:ui && pnpm run build:console
scripts.docs:features: node scripts/generate-feature-specs.mjs && node scripts/annotate-v015-saas.mjs && pnpm run ownership:refresh
scripts.build:ui: pnpm run build:ui-core && tsc -p packages/murphi-ui && tsc -p packages/murph-appui
scripts.typecheck:ui: pnpm run build:ui-core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/murphi-ui && tsc --noEmit -p packages/murph-appui
scripts.test:types: pnpm run typecheck:sdk && pnpm run typecheck:hooks
scripts.release:verify: pnpm run build:all && pnpm test && node scripts/release/verify-npm-packages.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write apps console examples packages scripts tests deploy infra sites/docs.json sites/storybook .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json sapling.config.ts 'vitest*.mts' types .prettierrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps console examples packages scripts tests deploy infra sites/docs.json sites/storybook .github package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json sapling.config.ts 'vitest*.mts' types .prettierrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --quiet apps console examples packages scripts tests sites/storybook
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix apps console examples packages scripts tests sites/storybook
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:all && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run typecheck:platforms && pnpm run typecheck:validation:compat && pnpm run typecheck:quality
